description: Pack the project folder at `path` (respects .gitignore; .env files are never uploaded; only files changed since the last deploy are uploaded), upload it and deploy every service it contains (frontend, API, workers) plus the Postgres/Redis/object storage the code needs. Waits until done and returns a DeployResult JSON: `status` is `live` (see `urls`), `failed` (with `error.cause`, `error.file` and `error.fix`; a redeploy rebuilds only changed services) or `needs_input` (missing secrets listed in `error.missing` / `plan.missingSecrets`, which `env_set` stores). `dry_run: true` previews the detected services, data, env wiring and assumptions without deploying. `env` sets plain env vars/secrets for this deploy (values are never echoed back). `needs_approval` means a migration would destroy data (see `error.approval`): once the user approves at `error.approval.url`, deploy again with `approval_token`.

approval_token.description: Token from the approval page after a deploy returned needs_approval (a destructive migration).

clean.description: Rebuild every service from scratch without build/dependency caches. Slower; use when a cached dependency looks stale or broken.

dry_run.description: Only detect and return the deploy plan; nothing is built or changed.

env.description: Env vars to set before deploying, e.g. {"STRIPE_SECRET_KEY": "..."}.

path.description: Absolute path (or relative to the server's working directory) of the project root to deploy.

project.description: Project slug. Optional: defaults to rivtor.json in the working directory, else its folder name.

verify.description: False skips functional checks, but mandatory client-secret scanning always runs.

name: deploy
title: Deploy a local folder
